scope.mathematical_claim: Candidate aggregate formula derived from periodic-core reduction, permutation/equivalence pair count, and fixed-root forest enumeration.

formula.integer_partition_function: p(k) is the number of integer partitions of k
formula.arithmetic_note: In the displayed Python implementation, division by (n-k)! is exact because (n-k)! divides n!, but this fact alone does not establish the combinatorial formula.

T5A_k_factorial_p_k.basis: For each integer-partition block-size profile, the number of equivalence relations multiplied by the size of its stabilizer is k!. Summing over p(k) profiles yields k! p(k).

PB_CORE_004_restriction_extension.note: Choose r=T^L where L is at least a transient-depth bound and divisible by every cycle length. An arbitrary h satisfying T^h(X)=P need not fix P pointwise.
